title: Alien Surreal Dreamscape
description: A large blue dripping alien head with three eyes dominates the left side, while four orange surfboard-like shapes with small white alien heads extend from the right. A tiny human figure walks a dotted path through a field of purple flowers at the bottom, all set against a vibrant, multicolored paint splatter background filled with geometric shapes, spirals, and concentric circles.
